inlines.v: INTEST'ATE, adjective [Latin intestatus; in and testatus, testor, to make a will.] 1. Dying without having made a will. When a man dies intestate his estate is committed for settlement to administrators. 2. Not devised; not disposed of by will; as an intestate estate. INTEST'ATE, noun A person who dies without making a will.
